addxvalue.scope: Returns the first Cartesian vector for direction, position, baseline, uvw and magnetic measures, and an empty record for epoch, frequency, Doppler and radial velocity. Cyclic and excessively deep records are rejected safely.

asbaseline.scope: Passes through baselines and converts scalar/vector positions through ITRF into J2000 baselines.

baseline.scope: Defines scalar/vector baselines from Cartesian or spherical quantities and supports a reference origin. Rigid reference changes use the explicit frame.

cometangdiam.scope: Use twice the mean physical radius divided by the interpolated distance. Apply the CASA missing-data sentinel when there is no epoch or no table sample.

cometdist.scope: Interpolate the Cartesian table position at the frame epoch and return its norm in AU. Use the CASA missing-data sentinel outside the table and when the epoch is absent.

cometname.scope: Read the object name of the selected table, or return an empty string and warn with no table.

comettopo.scope: Return the Cartesian observing position in metres for a topocentric table, or CASA's empty-unit array sentinel.

comettype.scope: Report TOPO for a topocentric table, APP for another loaded reference, and none with no table.

direction.scope: Defines measures and converts them between reference frames with casacore's conversions; a conversion lacking a frame element fails with CASA's message (decision empty-frame).

dirshow.scope: Shows measures as CASA shows them.

doframe.scope: Sets explicit epoch, position, direction and radial-velocity frame elements. The initial frame is empty under the recorded owner decision.

done.scope: Queries measure records as CASA does.

doppler.scope: Defines Doppler measures in all CASA conventions and aliases, including scalar quantities, reference offsets, default/invalid-reference behavior and CASA Python argument forms.

earthmagnetic.scope: Defines field strength and direction in the supported reference, reads explicit magnetic vectors and evaluates IGRF at the frame position and exact TDB epoch. Explicit IGRF outputs use ITRF coordinates. Reference changes preserve the input field strength.

epoch.scope: Defines measures and converts them between reference frames with casacore's conversions; a conversion lacking a frame element fails with CASA's message (decision empty-frame).

expand.scope: Returns ordered pair differences for position, baseline and uvw vectors with the original type and reference. Single input returns its coordinates. Failures return empty records.

framecomet.scope: Load, replace or clear the selected comet ephemeris using an explicit table path or a path relative to the runtime ephemerides or geodetic directory.

framenow.scope: Sets the frame's epoch, position and direction.

frequency.scope: Defines measures and converts them between reference frames with casacore's conversions; a conversion lacking a frame element fails with CASA's message (decision empty-frame). Undefined is retained; cross-frame conversions to or from it return an empty record, as in CASA.

getoffset.scope: Copies offsets for all nine measure kinds, retaining scalar/vector/nested values and large integers. Recursive and object-array records are rejected safely.

getref.scope: Queries measure records as CASA does.

gettype.scope: Queries measure records as CASA does.

getvalue.scope: Queries measure records as CASA does.

ismeasure.scope: Queries measure records as CASA does.

linelist.scope: The rest lines of the measures data, their names joined by spaces in the table's order, with CASA's deprecation warning.

listcodes.scope: The measures data's observatories and sources, and casacore's reference codes.

measure.scope: Defines measures and converts them between reference frames with casacore's conversions; a conversion lacking a frame element fails with CASA's message (decision empty-frame). Undefined is retained; cross-frame conversions to or from it return an empty record, as in CASA. Reads and converts baseline, UVW and earth magnetic measures. Generic output reference offsets are still unfinished (#1252).

observatory.scope: The measures data's observatories and sources, found by name as casacore's MeasTable finds them (ignoring case, or by a unique prefix), and casacore's reference codes.

obslist.scope: The observatories of the measures data, by name in the table's order, as CASA lists them; CASA's readantenna, sensitivity and itrf2locname, and simobserve, call it.

posangle.scope: Angular separation and position angle, as casacore computes them.

position.scope: Defines measures and converts them between reference frames with casacore's conversions; a conversion lacking a frame element fails with CASA's message (decision empty-frame).

radialvelocity.scope: Defines radial-velocity measures in all CASA reference codes, including scalar quantities, offsets and CASA Python argument forms. Cross-reference conversions require explicit frame elements under the existing owner decision.

rise.scope: Raises NotImplementedError naming #1252. CASA's simulation tasks and simutil do not call it.

riseset.scope: Raises NotImplementedError naming #1252. CASA's simutil.ephemeris calls it; ephemeris is not implemented either.

separation.scope: Angular separation and position angle, as casacore computes them.

shift.scope: Shift the first direction of a scalar or vector record by an offset and a position angle while retaining its reference origin. Preserve CASA's starting-pole convention.

show.scope: Shows measures as CASA shows them.

showframe.scope: Raises NotImplementedError naming #1252. CASA's simulation tasks and simutil do not call it.

source.scope: The measures data's observatories and sources, and casacore's reference codes.

sourcelist.scope: The sources of the measures data, their names joined by spaces in the table's order, as CASA lists them.

spectralline.scope: The rest frequency of a line in the measures data's Lines table, found by name as casacore finds it, REST frame; HI is casacore's QC::HI constant, as in CASA. CASA's simulation tasks and simutil do not call it.

todoppler.scope: Converts raw frequency or radial-velocity records to Doppler conventions, with CASA rest-frequency readers and scalar/vector records. Frequency-vector results use independent CASA scalar controls where its vector path rejects valid inputs.

tofrequency.scope: Converts Doppler records to frequencies using CASA QuantumHolder rest-frequency units, resolving Doppler offsets and preserving vector elements rather than CASA truncation.

toradialvelocity.scope: Converts Doppler records to radial-velocity references, resolving Doppler offsets and preserving all vector elements, checked against independent CASA scalar calls.

torestfrequency.scope: Derives rest frequency from raw frequency and resolved Doppler records, with scalar broadcasting and every vector result checked against independent CASA scalar calls.

touvw.scope: Converts scalar/vector baselines to J2000 uvw, flattened Cartesian coordinates and sidereal rates using the explicit frame.

type.scope: Queries measure records as CASA does.

uvw.scope: Defines scalar/vector uvw measures from Cartesian or spherical quantities and retains valid reference offsets.

decisions.record: The measures tool converts with a frame at MJD 0 and the geocentre
decisions.inputs: me.measure(me.direction('J2000','12h00m00','45d00m00'),'AZEL') in a fresh measures tool, with no doframe call.
decisions.casa: The tool starts with a default frame (MJD 0 UTC, zero-vector position, J2000 pole) and converts using it without a warning, returning AZEL for 1858-11-17 at the Earth's centre.
decisions.ours: Starts with an empty frame, so the conversion fails with 'Cannot convert due to missing frame information' until doframe sets the element.
decisions.rationale: A conversion should not silently use placeholder epoch and position.
decisions.impact: A script that forgot doframe gets an error rather than a meaningless answer.

decisions.record: IAU 2000 keeps the IAU 1980 sidereal time and ecliptic obliquities
decisions.inputs: Conversions to HADEC, AZEL, ITRF, MECLIPTIC or TECLIPTIC with measures.iau2000.b_use set.
decisions.casa: casacore still forms GAST from IAU 1982 GMST and the IAU 1980 equation of the equinoxes, and uses IAU 1980 obliquities (fundArg T^2 term -0.0059 arcsec, 0.37 mas in MECLIPTIC by 2026).
decisions.ours: Computes all of these as casacore does (casacore_sidereal, casacore_frames).
decisions.rationale: Follows casacore for parity; it moved IAU 2000A J2000 to HADEC from 20.4 to 16.7 mas off casacore.
decisions.impact: Results under IAU 2000 match casacore, including its remaining IAU 1980 pieces.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA's behaviour is deliberate or users' results depend on it, casa-rs follows it.

decisions.record: Direction latitudes come from an unnormalized vector
decisions.inputs: Direction conversions that use the galactic or FK4 matrices, e.g. B1950 to GALACTIC or J2000 to B1950 near a pole.
decisions.casa: The 10-digit literal matrices are orthogonal only to about 7e-11 and doConvert does not renormalize, so getLat's asin(z) is off by (|v|-1)tan(b) and becomes NaN once z exceeds 1.
decisions.ours: Converts with the same matrices, renormalizes and reports the latitude of the unit vector.
decisions.impact: Reported angles differ by up to 51 microarcsec (1.6 mas at b=-89.77 deg) while directions agree to 0.01 microarcsec.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: IAU 2000 JMEAN to J2000 applies bias and precession in the wrong order
decisions.inputs: MECLIPTIC or TECLIPTIC to J2000 conversion under IAU 2000.
decisions.casa: deapplyPrecession applies B then P giving P*B*v', not the inverse B*P*v', so JMEAN to J2000 is not the inverse of J2000 to JMEAN (0.14 mas off in 2026, growing).
decisions.rationale: The reverse transform must invert the forward one.
decisions.impact: Round trips through the IAU 2000 ecliptics differ from casacore by 0.14 mas in 2026.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: IAU 2000 GMST1 adds the TT day fraction
decisions.inputs: UT1 to GMST1 (and so LMST) under IAU 2000.
decisions.casa: UT1_GMST1 adds GMST00/(2pi), already a sidereal time of day, to the TT epoch, counting the TT day fraction twice: UT1 51544.5 gives GMST1 58258.280 against 58257.779, and GMST1_UT1 does not undo it.
decisions.ours: Uses the IAU 1976 GMST1 under either model, as casacore's own GAST does.
decisions.rationale: This keeps GMST1, LMST, GAST and LAST consistent with each other.
decisions.impact: LMST differs from casacore's IAU 2000 value but agrees with casacore under IAU 1976.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: Measures spectral conversions reject or truncate valid vectors
decisions.inputs: Frequency/Doppler vectors passed to spectral helpers; cyclic list/dictionary arguments passed to doppler or todoppler.
decisions.casa: CASA 6.7.6.14 truncates tofrequency, toradialvelocity and torestfrequency vectors, rejects a valid unframed todoppler frequency vector, and terminates with SIGSEGV on the recorded cyclic arguments.
decisions.ours: Preserves every scalar-control result with scalar broadcasting; rejects cyclic/deep inputs with catchable ValueError and restores capture state after failure.
decisions.rationale: Correct scientific data loss, process crashes and behavior contradicting the scalar helper intent.
decisions.impact: Vector callers receive all requested results. Invalid cyclic arguments no longer terminate the process.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md CASA deviations: correct CASA crashes, data loss and contradictions of evident intent.

decisions.record: Measures geometry constructors lose values and mislabel units
decisions.inputs: Length-first baseline/UVW quantities, incompatible dimensions, valid UVW reference offsets and spherical magnetic fields.
decisions.casa: Can replace valid geometry with zero, discard the UVW offset, or mislabel tesla as nanotesla and magnetic extra values as metres.
decisions.ours: Retains geometry and its reference origin, checks dimensions, and returns magnetic components in nanotesla.
decisions.rationale: The angle-first constructor, generic measure offset and explicit Cartesian magnetic records supply independent controls for data and unit corruption.
decisions.impact: Geometry and magnetic field strengths are preserved with consistent units.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md CASA deviations: correct data loss, corruption and contradictions of evident intent.

decisions.record: Failed measures geometry calls can expose earlier outputs
decisions.inputs: Failed touvw or expand following a successful call, and expand with an incompatible magnetic measure.
decisions.casa: Can return stale auxiliary results or relabel an incompatible record with zero length coordinates.
decisions.ours: Returns empty records for all outputs on failure and refuses non-geometric expansion.
decisions.rationale: Auxiliary values must correspond to the requested inputs.
decisions.impact: Callers can identify missing or incompatible results from all outputs.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md CASA deviations: correct data loss, corruption and contradictions of evident intent.

decisions.record: Magnetic reference changes can corrupt field strength
decisions.inputs: Physical-strength fields transformed through diurnal aberration or directly between B1950 and APP.
decisions.casa: Changes field strength. For 37416.574 nT in B1950, the APP result has norm 22289.454 nT. A physical-strength reverse input produces NaNs.
decisions.ours: Uses the casacore conversion route on a unit vector, then restores the original field strength.
decisions.rationale: Direction corrections should leave field strength invariant. Independent CASA direction conversions supply the control.
decisions.impact: Corrects the changed magnitudes and finite-input NaNs.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md CASA deviations: correct data loss, corruption and contradictions of evident intent.

decisions.record: Comet numeric queries can terminate without an epoch
decisions.inputs: A loaded comet table followed by cometdist or cometangdiam without setting an epoch, including after done.
decisions.ours: Reports the missing epoch and returns the existing -1 AU or -1 rad missing-data sentinel.
decisions.rationale: A missing input frame element must not terminate the caller.
decisions.impact: Callers can set an epoch and retry using the same table.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md CASA deviations: correct crashes and keep the approved empty initial frame.

decisions.record: Direction shifts can use the wrong longitude quadrant
decisions.inputs: Angular direction offsets crossing a pole or reaching the other longitude quadrant.
decisions.casa: The inverse sine restricts longitude to the near quadrant. A 120-degree east shift moves 60 degrees, and a northward shift across the pole can leave the direction unchanged.
decisions.ours: Selects the longitude quadrant from both tangent-plane components. Retains the CASA convention when the input itself is exactly at a pole.
decisions.rationale: The documented operation gives a direction at the requested angular separation and position angle.
decisions.impact: Produces the intended separation and position angle for valid large shifts and pole crossings.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md CASA deviations: correct results contradicting the documented operation.

signature.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14's methods, names and defaults, and the object-surface bundle's; not behavior.

refusals.scope: Each method casa-rs does not implement raises NotImplementedError naming #1252.

casa-values.result: 39 of the 78 tests pass against CASA 6.7.6.14's own me tool, including every measure, conversion and query value. Of the 39 others, 30 test what only casa-rs has, 8 assert messages CASA writes to its own log, and 1 is the recorded empty-frame decision; the receipt classifies each. casa-rs passes the same tests in CI.
casa-values.scope: Every implemented method, with CASA's messages.

bugs-record.scope: Each deviation's inputs, CASA's behaviour and casa-rs's, with the CASA source lines.

casa-lists.result: Recorded from CASA 6.7.6-14 by measures_lists_oracle.py, with how CASA makes each list from its table. obslist and linelist equal CASA's character for character (the tables are the same in both data versions); sourcelist is checked against casa-rs's own Sources table, which its data version holds with more rows than CASA's 1139. Passes in the Python tests.

casa-observatories.result: Recorded from CASA 6.7.6-14 by observatories_oracle.py with each observatory's table row: me.observatory for all 59 observatories equals CASA's to 1e-14 relative, ITRF entries included, which casacore reads from Long, Lat and Height and not X, Y, Z (#1106). Passes in the Python tests.
casa-observatories.scope: me.observatory for every name me.obslist gives.

casa-names.result: Recorded from CASA 6.7.6-14 by measures_names_oracle.py: me.observatory for 471 names and me.spectralline for 125 (every prefix of every entry's name, upper and lower case, and names longer than an entry or with spaces around them), and me.source for 10. casa-rs finds what CASA finds for each, by casacore's MUString::minimaxNC rule (#1110). Passes in the Python tests.
casa-names.scope: How me.observatory, me.spectralline and me.source find an entry by name.

undefined-frequency-casa.result: CASA 6.7.6-14 records Undefined frequency identity and refusal of cross-frame conversions, component tables with string, explicit, remapped and inferred integer references, invalid table-reference aliases, and MS mappings in which code 64 means LSRK and 9 means Undefined; type-only MS frequency metadata defaults to REST, while an integer reference column with no mapping arrays uses standard codes.
undefined-frequency-casa.scope: Undefined frequency measures, component-list frame updates and table reference mappings.

no-comet-casa.scope: measures comet getters without a loaded comet table.

getoffset-casa.scope: measures.getoffset for supported scalar direction, epoch, position and frequency records.

addxvalue-casa.scope: measures.addxvalue for scalar directions, positions, epoch and frequency records.

spectral-casa.kind: CASA 6.7.6.14 scalar/vector/offset comparisons and release performance
spectral-casa.scope: Six spectral methods and their shared query/frame/offset paths; full measures acceptance remains open.
spectral-casa.result: 558 CASA 6.7.6.14 cases plus 3 isolated safety regressions pass. All eight shared-code review findings have independent regressions and are repaired. The affected 920-test Python batch and 61 Rust/provider tests pass across the recorded runs; optional skips are excluded. All 12 release cases are faster than CASA, minimum 5.2370x.

geometry-casa.scope: Six geometry methods, their common record consumers, and rigid reference conversions on the bundled measures snapshot.
geometry-casa.result: 380 CASA geometry cases or independent controls pass on the bundled snapshot. The affected Python selection passes 1153 tests. All 24 release benchmark calls are faster than CASA, with a minimum 1.98x speedup.

comet-casa.result: 25 recorded sequences (199 steps) and the upstream distance/diameter assertions pass. All 10 release cases are faster than CASA (1.19x minimum).
